这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的图像到图像工作流程，可与 Z-Image Base 模型或其等效的 GGUF 模型一起使用。我制作此工作流程是为了使用 Z-Image Base 出色的 AI 摄影功能将平面矢量或动漫图像转换为 AI 照片。它目前不传输姿势，只是基于稍微改变的提示的概念，降噪值在 0.70 到 0.90 之间（但一旦 ControlNet Union 可用于 ZiB，我将创建一个 Controlnet 姿势传输版本）。我使用完整的非蒸馏基础模型和 Q6 模型来测试此工作流程，并且两者都与我的 8GB AMD GPU 配合良好。但如果你的 GPU 较弱，你可以从这些 HuggingFace Repos 中找到其他低级硬件支持的 GGUF 模型 -

Jayn7 的 Z-Image Base GGUF 模型的 HuggingFace 存储库 -

--------------------------------------------------------

https://huggingface.co/jayn7/Z-Image-GGUF/tree/main

Unsloth 的用于 Z-Image Base GGUF 模型的 QWEN3 GGUF 文本编码器 -

------------------------------------------------------------------

https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-4B-GGUF/tree/main

新发布的 Z-Image Base 模型由 Tongyi-MAI（阿里巴巴人工智能实验室）开发，是 Z-Image 系列的非蒸馏基础，旨在作为开源社区的“原始”起点。 Z-Image Turbo 是针对超快性能和亚秒级推理而优化的精炼版本，仅需 8 个步骤，与此不同的是，Base 模型是一个全权重检查点，需要更多步骤（通常为 28 至 50 个），但在姿势、构图和艺术风格方面提供了显着更高的多样性。虽然 Z-Image Turbo 专门针对即时照片真实感和消费级 GPU 效率进行了调整，但 Z-Image Base 是为需要更灵活的模型来微调、训练 LoRA 或实现复杂的提示遵守的研究人员和创作者而构建的，而更快、更“固执己见”的 Turbo 变体可能会错过这些。与 Z-Image 等其他专业版本相比 Edit 专门针对基于指令的图像到图像任务进行了微调，Base 模型提供了最中性和最不精致的数据分布，对于那些希望将 60 亿参数的 S3-DiT 架构推向速度以外的新的创意领域的人来说，它是最佳选择。

您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载所需的文件（详情如下）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器或您可能拥有的任何其他缺失节点安装 ComfyUI 的 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、Flux.2 Klein、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、Z-Image Turbo 和 Flux 的其他工作流程。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需首先选择您想要的 Z-Image Base（或将其与 GGUF 模型文件交换）模型文件

#2.现在为图像到图像过程选择参考图像

＃3。然后输入你的正面和负面提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用，也可以添加新的 LORA，按顶部的 L 按钮即可在新选项卡上的 LORA Manager 中找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的风筝按钮。对于这两个示例图像，我使用了 Z IMAGE PAWG LORA 作为 Z-Image Base，来自这里 -https://civitai.com/models/2262743/z-image-pawg?modelVersionId=2639737

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Image-to-Image workflow that will work with Z-Image Base model or it's GGUF model equivalents. I made this workflow to use Z-Image Base's awesome AI photograpic capabilities to convert flat vector or anime images to AI photos. It currently does not transfer poses just concepts based on slightly altered prompts out of original with denoise value between 0.70 to 0.90 (but I will create a Controlnet pose tranfer version once ControlNet Union will be available for ZiB). I used BOTH full non-distilled base model and a Q6 Model to test this workflow and both work well with my 8GB AMD GPU. But if you have a weaker GPU you can find other low grade hardware supported GGUF models from these HuggingFace Repos -

Jayn7's HuggingFace repo for Z-Image Base GGUF models -

--------------------------------------------------------

https://huggingface.co/jayn7/Z-Image-GGUF/tree/main

Unsloth's QWEN3 GGUF Text Encoders for Z-Image Base GGUF models -

------------------------------------------------------------------

https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-4B-GGUF/tree/main

The newly released Z-Image Base model, developed by Tongyi-MAI (Alibaba's AI lab), is the non-distilled foundation of the Z-Image family, designed to serve as the "raw" starting point for the open-source community. Unlike Z-Image Turbo, which is a distilled version optimized for ultra-fast performance and sub-second inference using as few as 8 steps, the Base model is a full-weight checkpoint that requires more steps (typically 28 to 50) but offers significantly higher diversity in poses, compositions, and artistic styles. While Z-Image Turbo is specifically tuned for immediate photorealism and consumer-grade GPU efficiency, Z-Image Base is built for researchers and creators who need a more flexible model for fine-tuning, training LoRAs, or achieving complex prompt adherence that the faster, more "opinionated" Turbo variant might miss. Compared to other specialized versions like Z-Image Edit, which is fine-tuned specifically for instruction-based image-to-image tasks, the Base model provides the most neutral and unrefined data distribution, making it the superior choice for those looking to push the 6-billion parameter S3-DiT architecture into new, creative territories beyond just speed.

You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager or any other missing nodes you may have and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, Flux.2 Klein, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, Z-Image Turbo and Flux. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Z-Image Base (or swap it with GGUF model files) model files first and now

#2. now select a Reference Image for Image-to-Image process

#3. then input your positive and negative prompts.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs, too add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button. For both example Images I used this Z IMAGE PAWG LORA for Z-Image Base from here -https://civitai.com/models/2262743/z-image-pawg?modelVersionId=2639737
